question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Respect
solution:
The correct answer is: **Honour**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Respect"** means a feeling of deep admiration for someone or something elicited by their abilities, qualities, or achievements. (सम्मान)
 
 
• **Example: **He has great respect for his teachers.
 
 
 
• **"Honour"** refers to high respect or great esteem. (सम्मान)
 
 
• **Example: **It is an honour to receive this award.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym of **'Respect'** is **'Honour'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Honour**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disrespect** (असम्मान): Lack of respect or courtesy.
 
 
• **Example:** His rude behavior showed a clear disrespect for authority.
 
 
 
• **Invalidate** (अमान्य करना): To make an argument, statement, or theory unsound or erroneous.
 
 
• **Example:** The new evidence will invalidate the previous theory.
 
 
 
• **Attend** (भाग लेना): To be present at an event, meeting, or function.
 
 
• **Example:** She will attend the conference next week.
 
 

3c:Ta18,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
